lines.japanese: わたしは……。
ある疾病を……かかえている……。
lines.english: have... an illness...

lines.japanese: 病名は伏せる……そこに意味はないから……。
lines.english: I won't name it... There's no point...

lines.japanese: これが、わたしの家……。
lines.english: This is my home...

lines.japanese: たばこ屋をいとなんでいる、わたしの家……。
lines.english: My home... where we run a tobacco shop...

lines.japanese: これが、わたし……。
lines.english: This is me...

lines.japanese: 今夜のわたし……。
lines.english: Me, tonight...

lines.japanese: これは一日前、きのうのわたし……。
lines.english: This is me one day ago... yesterday...

lines.japanese: きのうの朝のわたし……。
lines.english: Me, yesterday morning...

lines.japanese: 「みやこー、学校おくれるよー」
lines.english: “Miyako! You'll be late for school!”

lines.japanese: これも、きのうのわたし……。
lines.english: This is me yesterday too...

lines.japanese: きのうの、夕方のわたし……。
lines.english: Me, yesterday evening...

lines.japanese: 「みやこー、ちょっと店番たのめるー？」
lines.english: “Miyako! Can you watch the shop for a bit?”

lines.japanese: これも、きのうのわたし……。
lines.english: This is me yesterday too...

lines.japanese: きのうの、夜のわたし……。
lines.english: Me, last night...

lines.japanese: 「みやこー、みんな帰ってきたから晩ごはんにするよー」
lines.english: “Miyako! Everyone's home, so we're having dinner!”

lines.japanese: きのうは、終日この調子……。
lines.english: Yesterday, I was like this all day...

lines.japanese: まるで、駄目人間……。
lines.english: Like a complete waste of space...

lines.japanese: まるで、いとこのトシ兄さん……。
lines.english: Like my cousin Toshi...

lines.japanese: トシ兄さんは、週に二回のバイト以外、部屋にこもってネット三昧……。
lines.english: Apart from his twice-weekly shifts at work, Toshi stays in his room... doing nothing but going online...

lines.japanese: ご両親も、困っている……でも、いまトシ兄さんのことは、どうでもいい……。
lines.english: His parents are troubled too... But right now, Toshi doesn't matter...

lines.japanese: どうでもいい……どうでもいい……。
lines.english: It doesn't matter... It doesn't matter...

lines.japanese: 何もかも、どうでもいい……。
lines.english: Nothing matters...

lines.japanese: けれどいまは、どうでもいいわたしのこと……
lines.english: But right now... I'll talk about me, who doesn't matter...

lines.japanese: 山科京という、どうでもいい屑のことについて、語る……。
lines.english: About the worthless piece of trash called Miyako Yamashina...

lines.japanese: ひとまず……記録を早送りしよう……。
lines.english: For now... let's fast-forward the recording...

lines.japanese: これは……いまから３時間前の、わたし……。
lines.english: This is... me, three hours ago...

lines.japanese: 「きゃああああ！　素敵ィー！　サイコー！」
lines.english: “Aaaaah! Amazing! They’re the best!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、瑠樺ちゃんコレ！　この曲アレ、限定版のボーナストラックの！」
lines.english: “Oh, Ruka, this one! This is that song, the bonus track on the limited edition!”

lines.japanese: 「やあああ！　うそ、サンデーナイトメア！？　えええ、なんでなんで！　これやるの？　やだ嬉しい、嬉しい嬉しい泣きそう、きゃああああ！」
lines.english: “Aaaaah! No way, Sunday Nightmare?! What, why, why?! They're playing this? Oh, I'm so happy, happy, happy, I'm gonna cry, aaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「あーっ、うそマジで！　やばい瑠樺ちゃん、いまクリヤこっち見たよ！」
lines.english: “Oh my god, seriously! Ruka, this is insane! KuRiYa just looked at us!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃああああ、クリヤぁぁぁ！」
lines.english: “Aaaaah! Kuriyaaaa!”

lines.japanese: これはひどい……。
lines.english: This is awful...

lines.japanese: まるで、ふつうの女の子……。
lines.english: Like an ordinary girl...

lines.japanese: まるで、同じクラスの高内さんや岡村さん……。
lines.english: Like Takauchi or Okamura in my class...

lines.japanese: 高内さんたちは……相手の本質に拘泥せず……外殻次第で異性と交接……。
lines.english: Takauchi and the others... don't concern themselves with a person's essence... They mate with the opposite sex according to its outer shell...

lines.japanese: 性の乱れ……識者たちが、嘆いている……でも、いま彼女らのことは、どうでもいい……。
lines.english: Loose sexual morals... The experts lament it... But right now, those girls don't matter...

lines.japanese: いまは、わたしのこと……山科京という、この生きている価値もない屑について、語らねばならない……。
lines.english: Right now, I must talk about me... About this piece of trash called Miyako Yamashina, whose life isn't even worth anything...

lines.japanese: ふたたび記録を、早送りしよう……。
lines.english: Let's fast-forward the recording again...

lines.japanese: これが、その３時間後……つまり、現在のわたし……。
lines.english: This is me three hours later... In other words, me now...

lines.japanese: 「みやこー？　帰ってきてるのー？」
lines.english: “Miyako? Are you home?”

lines.japanese: やっぱり、駄目人間……。
lines.english: A waste of space after all...

lines.japanese: 端的にいえば……この、顕著なアップダウンの、激しさが……わたしの病気……。
lines.english: To put it simply... the sheer intensity of these pronounced ups and downs... is my illness...

lines.japanese: このことは、めったに口外、しない……。
lines.english: I hardly ever speak about it...

lines.japanese: なぜなら……大抵の場合、ある種の好ましからざる、印象を……与えてしまうから……。
lines.english: Because... in most cases... it gives people a certain... unwelcome impression...

lines.japanese: たとえば……松葉杖をついていれば、痛そうだねと、労わってくれる……。
lines.english: For instance... if you're on crutches, people say it must hurt... and treat you gently...

lines.japanese: レントゲンに影でも映れば、大変だねと、案じてくれる……。
lines.english: If there's a shadow on an X-ray... they say it must be hard... and worry about you...

lines.japanese: でもわたしの病気は……そういう、確たる証が提示できない……だから、胡乱な泣き言と思われて、おしまい……。
lines.english: But with my illness... I can't show any definite proof like that... So people dismiss it as dubious whining... and that's that...

lines.japanese: 当然だと、思う……。
lines.english: I think that's only natural...

lines.japanese: もしわたしが、逆の立ち場なら……たぶん、同じことを思う……。
lines.english: If our positions were reversed... I'd probably think the same thing...

lines.japanese: こんな、五体満足なくせに、ぐちぐちぐちぐちと、泣き言ばかりの面倒な女には……侮蔑の嘲笑を、浴びせるはず……。
lines.english: A tiresome girl with a perfectly intact body... whining and whining and whining... I'd surely shower her with contemptuous laughter...

lines.japanese: 「うざい」
lines.english: “You're annoying.”

lines.japanese: 「消えろ」
lines.english: “Disappear.”

lines.japanese: 「いなくなれ」
lines.english: “Go away.”

lines.japanese: うん……同感……。
lines.english: Yes... I agree...

lines.japanese: ほんとうに……こんな鬱陶しいやつは、消えてしまうべきだと、心から賛同する……。
lines.english: Truly... someone this tiresome ought to disappear... I agree with all my heart...

lines.japanese: 消えたいなあ……。
lines.english: I wish I could disappear...

lines.japanese: ああ、消したいなあ……。
lines.english: Oh, I wish I could erase...

lines.japanese: みんなの慈悲深い目がかえって卑しいわたしに恐怖を与えるから誰の視界にも入らない場所へと飛びたってしまいたいなあ……。
lines.english: Everyone's merciful eyes only frighten someone as low as me, so I wish I could fly away somewhere nobody could see me...

lines.japanese: こんな青臭い、ありふれた、酔いしれた、個性的なつもりで実は一文字残らず誰かの爪の垢で構成されたわたしたちの年代特有のはしかみたいな白々しい告白を他の自我には決して晒したくないなあ……。
lines.english: I never want to expose to another self a confession this immature, commonplace, intoxicated with itself, pretending to be original when every last letter is made from the grime under someone else's fingernails, this insincere affliction peculiar to our age, like the measles...

lines.japanese: だから、ほんとうは、いますぐこの記録簿を閉じてほしい……。
lines.english: So, really... I'd like you to close this journal right now...

lines.japanese: みなさんの貴重な時間を、こんな、つまらない愚図のために、浪費しないでください……。
lines.english: Please don't waste your precious time... on a boring, useless girl like this...

lines.japanese: 輝かしい未来が、待って、いるのでしょう……？
lines.english: You have... a bright future... waiting for you, don't you...?

lines.japanese: わたしは決して……世のみなさんに、理解や、同情や、憐憫その他……を求めようなどとは、思っていない……。
lines.english: I have no intention... of asking the people of the world for understanding... or sympathy... or pity, or anything else...

lines.japanese: たぶん。
lines.english: Probably.

lines.japanese: そんな大それた野望は、とうに、捨てさった……。
lines.english: I abandoned such grand ambitions... long ago...

lines.japanese: たぶん。
lines.english: Probably.

lines.japanese: だって、もはや自分すら愛していないこの身を、誰が赦してくれるというのか……。
lines.english: After all, who would forgive someone... who doesn't even love herself anymore...?

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Haaah.”

lines.japanese: 「死のうかな」
lines.english: “Maybe I should die.”

lines.japanese: 「むりだけど」
lines.english: “I can't, though.”

lines.japanese: それも恐いからね……。
lines.english: Because that's frightening too...

lines.japanese: ごめんなさい。分を弁えて隅のほう隅のほうで生きてゆきますので、厚かましいお願いではありますが、みなさんどうか温かい目でこの屑の命をお見逃しください。
lines.english: I'm sorry. I'll know my place and live in the farthest, farthest corner, so, presumptuous as this request may be, please look kindly on this piece of trash and allow her life to pass unnoticed.

lines.japanese: そして出来ることなら、やはり、いますぐにでもこの記録簿を閉じてください。
lines.english: And if possible, please do close this journal right now after all.

lines.japanese: いえ、山科京の分際で、恥ずかしいなどと一端の口をきくつもりは毛頭ございません。ただ、ただ一点、わたしどもの駄文で皆さんのお目を汚し、大事なお時間まで頂いてしまうのが本当に心苦しいのです。
lines.english: No, someone as lowly as Miyako Yamashina would never presume to say she was embarrassed. It's just that, just this one thing: it truly pains me to sully your eyes with my worthless writing and take up your valuable time as well.

lines.japanese: それでも（たとえば巣穴に餌をはこぶ蟻の姿がときに好奇の対象となるように）世界の底で這いつくばる女に一抹の興味をお持ちとあらば、もはやわたしもお止めはいたしません。
lines.english: Still, if you have the slightest interest in a woman crawling at the bottom of the world—as an ant carrying food to its nest can sometimes arouse curiosity—then I will no longer try to stop you.

lines.japanese: たいへん申しわけなく存じますが、しばしお付き合いのほどよろしくお願いいたします。
lines.english: I am terribly sorry, but I humbly ask you to stay with me a little while.

lines.japanese: でも皆さんお忙しいと思うので、ほんとうに、飽きたらすぐに放りだしてください。
lines.english: But I'm sure you're all busy, so please, truly, throw this aside the moment you get bored.

lines.japanese: それがわたしの本心──
lines.english: Those are my true feelings—

lines.japanese: ──ではありません。
lines.english: —except they aren't.

lines.japanese: ほら、めんどくさい女。
lines.english: See? A tiresome woman.

lines.japanese: だからあのひとにも捨てられたんだ。
lines.english: That's why that person abandoned me too.
